newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Sheet Glass French affiliate to shut.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Sheet Glass French affiliate to shut.

text.p: Nippon Sheet Glass Co Ltd said on Monday that its French affiliate, Glastron SA, has decided to close down because of sluggish business.
Nippon Sheet Glass and Saint-Gobain Vitrage of France each own half of the liquid crystal display (LCD) parts maker, it said in a statement.
Nippon Sheet Glass will post a 1.1 billion yen extraordinary loss in its earnings for the year to March 31, 1997, due to the unit's liquidation.
However, it said it would maintain its earnings forecast as it plans to offset the loss through the sale of securities.
